create_PASCALPARTEvaluator: create a PASCALPARTEvaluator instance to evaluate object detection on PASCAL-PART with open-vocabulary categories
run_PASCALPARTEvaluator_evaluate: run the PASCALPARTEvaluator to compute COCO-style AP metrics on bbox, segm, or keypoints predictions
derive_coco_results_PASCALPARTEvaluator: derive COCO evaluation results with per-category AP and seen/unseen class breakdown from a PASCALPARTEvaluator

tabulate_per_category_AP: tabulate per-category AP and AP50 results for all PASCAL-PART classes in open-vocabulary evaluation
